title: Single commutators in $C^*$-algebras
summary: Let $\mathcal A$ be a simple unital $C^*$-algebra with real rank zero, nonempty tracial state space $\mathcal T(\mathcal A)$, and strict comparison of projections. We prove that every element $T$ in $\mathcal A$ with $τ(T)=0$ for all $τ\in\mathcal T(\mathcal A)$ is a single commutator if one of the following conditions holds: $(1)$ $\mathcal A$ has unique trace; $(2)$ $\mathcal A$ has stable rank one. We also prove that every nonscalar element in a simple unital purely infinite $C^*$-algebra is a single commutator. Applications include UHF algebras, irrational rotation algebras, and Cuntz…
